name: Piston Automotive
old_description: We believe in the process, and it’s the quality of that process that makes all the difference. Our expertise in assembly systems creates unrivaled value for our customers. Our process-driven approach not only makes better builds, it builds better value.
about:
Piston Automotive is headquartered in Marion, Ohio. The company was founded by Vinnie Johnson, though the founding year is not publicly disclosed. The business began with a focus on automotive assembly and has grown into a multi-system integrator for vehicle manufacturers.

The company specializes in advanced assembly and manufacturing across major vehicle systems: electrical and battery, powertrain and cooling, interior, exterior, and chassis. Its capabilities span process engineering, design and development, product design and prototype testing, and total solution supply chain management. Piston Automotive describes itself as a total solution provider, integrating assembly with logistics and engineering support.

Piston Automotive serves the automotive industry, with a noted emphasis on electrification. Its customer base includes industry-leading vehicle manufacturers seeking a partner for complex assembly programs. The company highlights experience in electrified vehicle systems, though specific client names are not disclosed.

The company differentiates itself through a process-driven philosophy summarized as "Our Process is Our Product." It emphasizes continuous improvement, a "get it done" mentality, and a partner mindset that aims to add value at every stage of a program. Leadership states that excellence is an all-in commitment, with no small parts or details overlooked.
